question: The second edition of the Indian Bison Fest (Gaur Fest) in March 2026 was held at which wildlife sanctuary?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Debrigarh Wildlife Sanctuary.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Event:** The second edition of the **Indian Bison Fest** (also known as **Gaur Fest**) was held on **March 8–9, 2026**.
 
• **Venue:** The festival took place at **Zeropoint** inside the **Debrigarh Wildlife Sanctuary, **located in the Bargarh district in the Indian state of Odisha, covering a total area of 346.91 km². It is situated near the city of Sambalpur's Hirakud Dam. 
 
• **Organizer:** The event was organized by the **Hirakud Wildlife Division** to celebrate the conservation of the Indian Bison and promote eco-tourism.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Highlights__**

__
 
• **Conservation Success:** According to the census conducted in January 2026, the population of Indian Bison in Debrigarh reached **848**, marking an increase of 190 animals in just one year.
 
• **Local Name:** In Odisha, the Indian Bison is locally referred to as **‘Gayala’**.
 
• **New Features:** The 2026 edition introduced **night camping** and nature trails to provide students, researchers, and tourists with a deeper immersive experience of the sanctuary's ecosystem.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **About Debrigarh Wildlife Sanctuary__**

 
• **Location:** Situated near the **Hirakud Dam**, it is one of the most significant wildlife corridors in Odisha.
 
• **Status:** It is home to a diverse range of fauna, including leopards, sambar deer, and a variety of resident and migratory birds.
 
• **Historical Link:** The sanctuary is also associated with the freedom fighter **Veer Surendra Sai**, who used its dense forests as a base during his rebellion against the British.
